messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — planning to cut release/1.16 tomorrow at 10:00 PT. Need to confirm branch name, who creates it, and backport rules.

sam: +1 on time. who wants ownership of the actual branch creation? I can do it if needed.

lina: Are we doing semantic tag v1.16.0 or just release/1.16 branch for RCs?

marta: We do release/* branches (release/1.16). We'll tag v1.16.0 once RC is promoted.

oliver: For backports: current rule = only bugfixes with tests + changelog entry. No behavior changes post-cut. Is that still accurate?

marta: Yes. TL;DR: backport if 1) fixes a regression or blocker, 2) has tests, and 3) includes a CHANGES.md bullet. Use label backport/yes on the PR.

sam: Also add the checklist: PR must target main first, then cherry-pick to release/1.16. We should avoid direct commits to release/* unless emergency hotfix.

lina: For emergency hotfixes after cutoff, what's the process? create release/1.16-hotfix or hotfix/*?

marta: Create release/1.16-hotfix, open PR against that branch, include a short rationale and @marta or @sam review. We'll merge and then cherry-pick to main if needed.

oliver: Small nit — can we require a changelog label too? tests sometimes slip.

sam: agreed. label: changelog/required and backport/yes for any backport PR. devops: we can enforce via PR template.

release-bot: automated: reminder — cutting window scheduled: 2026-03-18 17:00:00 UTC (10:00 PT). I will attempt to create the release branch 10 mins prior. Ensure you have push perms.

devops: I checked perms — release-bot service account has branch-create rights but needs one human with write to approve branch protection exceptions.

marta: @sam can you confirm you'll be available at 09:50 PT to approve?

sam: Yep I'll be on standby.

lina: One more item: version bump. Who will update package.json / build.cfg and CHANGES.md before cut? We should avoid last-minute mismatch.

marta: Prefer to have a single owner for version bump. @oliver can you take that?

oliver: I can do it. I'll push a PR with the version bump + CHANGES.md draft by EOD today. Will tag @marta for quick review.

sam: Workflow note for branch creation:
```
# run locally
git checkout -b release/1.16 origin/main
git push origin release/1.16
# create PR if you need pre-rc changes, otherwise tag RC after cut
```

lina: For cherry-picks: use `git cherry-pick -x <sha>` and include the original PR link in description. That helps auditors.

marta: Good call. Also add the changelog bullet format: `component: short summary (#1234)` so we can auto-collect.

oliver: I'll include that format in my CHANGES.md PR.

sam: Quick ask — if someone has a backport candidate, please post the PR link here and add label backport/needs-review. We'll triage at 11:00 PT today.

marta: Final reminder: no API contract changes after cutoff. If something slips through, must be explicitly approved by product and eng leads. :warning:

lina: got it. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

release-bot: automated: branch creation scheduled — creating release/1.16 in 10 minutes. Success/failure will be posted to this thread.

devops: logging note — I've queued a job to check branch protection after creation and will post results.

sam: thanks all. I'll be available for the approval window.

marta: Great. If anything changes, update this thread.
